add_checked_sentence_to_input: add the checked sentence wrapped in knowledge tokens to the end of a message text field
use_checked_sentence_as_label: replace message labels with the checked sentence and store original labels as dialogue_response
add_label_to_input: append the dialogue response label wrapped in label tokens to the end of the message text
add_label_to_input_lm: split the dialogue response at a random word and wrap the second half in label tokens for language modeling
filter_episodes_by_passage_usage: filter dialogue episodes to include or exclude examples based on whether a knowledge passage was used
